caption: LUM-1245 tip: app.model.select (Ctrl+L) opens the model selector

panels.label: 1. idle startup frame: header still advertises Ctrl+L to select model; app.suspend / app.editor.external are gone
2. Ctrl+L -> the model selector overlay opens (before this fix Ctrl+L silently wiped the transcript)
3. Down -> selection moves inside the model list
4. Esc -> selector closes; the transcript is still there
5. /hotkeys -> app group no longer lists unimplemented chords
